run_reference_path_benchmark: run the reference path benchmark agent to evaluate navigation metrics on a set of episodes
run_vln_benchmark_cli: run the VLN benchmark CLI with a task config YAML to evaluate the reference path follower
test_reference_path_benchmark: test the reference_path_benchmark function by passing a habitat config and number of episodes
review_reference_path_benchmark: review the reference_path_benchmark function that uses ShortestPathFollower to navigate along ground truth reference paths
summarize_reference_path_benchmark: summarize the reference_path_benchmark function which aggregates navigation metrics across episodes using geodesic path following
